summary: Lolo NF site 15 miles west of Missoula that never had a permanent lookout; its lookout was a pop-up trailer from a 1959 batch of six. Listed gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed gone; firelookout.com says the trailers have all been retired from active service, but no source says what became of this site's unit

notes_for_editor: Site-specific material is thin. firelookout.com describes the trailer type and fleet; the Montana list gives the type and status. No source ties a particular trailer to Martin Point or dates any use there, so the story stays with the trailer type and the site's listing. Two searches found nothing site-specific. The firelookout.com page credits a Dave Bula collection photo but gives no image URL, so no photo was recorded. The brief's kind 'mobile' matches the list's 'Trailer'. No corrections.
